description: This PHP source file defines the ModuleInstaller class for SuiteCRM, handling module installation, uninstallation, extension management, relationship processing, and related tasks within the SuiteCRM module setup framework.

classes.name: ModuleInstaller
classes.description: This class manages the installation, uninstallation, extension management, and relationship setup of modules within SuiteCRM. It provides methods for copying files, installing custom fields, managing language packs, handling logic hooks, and rebuilding system components to ensure proper module integration.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Main method that initiates the installation process of a module from the specified base directory, including handling upgrades, merging extension files, rebuilding relationships, and clearing caches.

methods.name: install_user_prefs
methods.description: Updates all user preferences related to a specific module, showing or hiding tabs based on parameters.

methods.name: uninstall_user_prefs
methods.description: Removes all user preferences associated with a module, effectively resetting user settings.

methods.name: pre_execute
methods.description: Handles pre-installation steps, including executing any pre-logic defined in the manifest.

methods.name: post_execute
methods.description: Handles post-installation steps, including executing any post-logic defined in the manifest.

methods.name: pre_uninstall
methods.description: Prepares the system before uninstalling a module, executing any pre-uninstall scripts.

methods.name: post_uninstall
methods.description: Finalizes uninstallation, executing any post-uninstall scripts.

methods.name: install_copy
methods.description: Copies files defined in the install manifest from source to target locations.

methods.name: uninstall_copy
methods.description: Removes files copied during installation, restoring previous state if backups exist.

methods.name: uninstall_new_files
methods.description: Removes newly added files that were part of the module installation.

methods.name: getExtDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for extension files for a given module.

methods.name: installExt
methods.description: Installs extension files into the appropriate Ext directory based on section, extension name, and module.

methods.name: uninstallExt
methods.description: Removes extension files from the Ext directory corresponding to the specified section, extension, and module.

methods.name: rebuildExt
methods.description: Merges extension files into the main Ext PHP file for a specific extension.

methods.name: disableExt
methods.description: Disables extension files by moving them into a disabled directory.

methods.name: enableExt
methods.description: Re-enables extension files by moving them back from the disabled directory.

methods.name: uninstall_global_search
methods.description: Removes module entries from the global search configuration.

methods.name: enable_global_search
methods.description: Enables module entries in the global search configuration.

methods.name: disable_global_search
methods.description: Disables module entries in the global search configuration.

methods.name: install_extensions
methods.description: Installs all extensions specified in the module's extension list.

methods.name: uninstall_extensions
methods.description: Uninstalls all extensions in the module's extension list.

methods.name: rebuild_extensions
methods.description: Rebuilds all loaded extensions to apply changes.

methods.name: disable_extensions
methods.description: Disables all extensions listed.

methods.name: enable_extensions
methods.description: Enables all extensions listed.

methods.name: install_dashlets
methods.description: Installs dashlets defined in the module's install definitions.

methods.name: uninstall_dashlets
methods.description: Removes dashlets that were installed.

methods.name: install_images
methods.description: Copies theme images into the custom themes directory.

methods.name: install_dcactions
methods.description: Installs dashboard actions from the module definitions.

methods.name: uninstall_dcactions
methods.description: Removes dashboard actions associated with the module.

methods.name: install_connectors
methods.description: Installs connector sources and formatters for the module.

methods.name: uninstall_connectors
methods.description: Removes connector sources and formatters.

methods.name: install_vardef
methods.description: Installs vardef files for a module.

methods.name: install_layoutdef
methods.description: Installs layout definition files for a module.

methods.name: install_languages
methods.description: Installs language packs into the system.

methods.name: uninstall_languages
methods.description: Removes language packs.

methods.name: disable_languages
methods.description: Disables language packs by moving files to a disabled folder.

methods.name: enable_languages
methods.description: Enables language packs by moving files back from the disabled folder.

methods.name: enable_manifest_logichooks
methods.description: Enables logic hooks as specified in the manifest.

methods.name: disable_manifest_logichooks
methods.description: Disables logic hooks as specified in the manifest.

methods.name: uninstallLabels
methods.description: Removes labels from label files based on definitions.

methods.name: uninstallExtLabels
methods.description: Removes extended label files for specified languages and modules.

methods.name: getLabelsToUninstall
methods.description: Extracts label keys to uninstall from label definitions.

methods.name: copy_path
methods.description: Copies files or directories from a source to a target location, with optional backup handling.

methods.name: install_custom_fields
methods.description: Installs custom fields into specific modules.

methods.name: uninstall_custom_fields
methods.description: Removes custom fields from modules.

methods.name: install_relationships
methods.description: Installs relationship definitions and related metadata for a module.

methods.name: install_relationship
methods.description: Installs a specific relationship from a metadata file.

methods.name: install_layoutfields
methods.description: Installs layout field definitions.

methods.name: uninstall_layoutfields
methods.description: Removes layout field definitions.

methods.name: uninstall_relationship
methods.description: Removes relationship metadata and related database tables.

methods.name: uninstall_relationships
methods.description: Removes relationships and related metadata for a module.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Main method for uninstalling a module, executing cleanup, removal of relationships, files, and rebuilding system components.

methods.name: rebuild_languages
methods.description: Rebuilds language packs for specified languages and modules.

methods.name: rebuild_vardefs
methods.description: Rebuilds vardef files.

methods.name: rebuild_dashletcontainers
methods.description: Rebuilds dashlet container definitions.

methods.name: rebuild_tabledictionary
methods.description: Rebuilds the table dictionary extension files.

methods.name: rebuild_relationships
methods.description: Rebuilds all module relationships.

methods.name: remove_acl_actions
methods.description: Removes ACL actions for the module.

methods.name: repair_indices
methods.description: Calls the module to repair database indices.

methods.name: rebuild_all
methods.description: Rebuilds all extensions, languages, relationships, and cache after module modifications.

methods.name: merge_files
methods.description: Concatenates extension and application PHP files into single files for module or application extension points.

methods.name: install_modules
methods.description: Generates a PHP file with bean definitions and installs modules as per the install definitions.

methods.name: install_beans
methods.description: Instantiates beans, creates tables, and sets relationship metadata for modules.

methods.name: uninstall_beans
methods.description: Drops tables and removes relationships for modules.

methods.name: uninstall_customizations
methods.description: Removes custom directories created for modules.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages and echoes them if not silent.

methods.name: copy_recursive_with_backup
methods.description: Copies files recursively with backup support, optionally restoring from backups.

methods.name: dir_get_files
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all files in a directory.

methods.name: dir_file_count
methods.description: Counts all files in a directory recursively.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Sets error messages in session and redirects to the module upgrade page.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Retrieves errors stored during installation/uninstallation process.

methods.name: addFieldsToLayout
methods.description: Adds specified fields to module layout views if applicable.

methods.name: removeFieldsFromLayout
methods.description: Removes specified fields from module layout views if applicable.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables a module by copying files and enabling related features based on the manifest.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables a module by disabling files, relationships, and features based on the manifest.

methods.name: enable_vardef
methods.description: Enables vardefs for a specific module.

methods.name: enable_layoutdef
methods.description: Enables layout defs for a specific module.

methods.name: enable_relationships
methods.description: Enables module relationships and updates related definitions, files, and caches.

methods.name: disable_relationships
methods.description: Disables module relationships by moving metadata files into a disabled directory.

methods.name: enable_dashlets
methods.description: Enables dashlets for the module.

methods.name: disable_dashlets
methods.description: Disables dashlets for the module.

methods.name: enable_copy
methods.description: Copies files back from restore points during enable operation.

methods.name: disable_copy
methods.description: Restores files from backups during disable operation.

methods.name: reset_opcodes
methods.description: Resets cached PHP opcodes (script cache).

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic calls for extension-related enable, disable, install, uninstall, rebuild methods.
